title: QR pairing passes permission, connection and recovery checks
summary: 15 focused tests, TypeScript and lint pass. The QR option opens the in-app viewer and keeps approval and manual pairing intact.

changes.detail: Option 2 camera scanner, local session QR rendering, strict private Tailscale QR parsing and lecomax-learn phone links.
Pass a scanned code once to the embedded viewer in memory; preserve manual pairing, Android capture prompts and sharing-phone approval.
Prepare Android 1.0.12/build 14 with camera scanning and SVG support, without microphone recording permission.
Fit QR on narrow phones and refresh camera permission after returning from Android settings. Corrected TypeScript checks and deep-link state handling found during validation.

validation.name: Focused interaction and history checks
validation.detail: 15 tests passed: actual page QR display/hide, manual pairing, scan-to-viewer and incoming-link flow, no code persisted, permission denial, settings path, background camera pause, invalid/duplicate scans, one-time WebView handoff, owner approval and recovery/history regressions.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused ESLint
validation.detail: Typecheck and lint of phone page, viewer, scanner and pairing parser passed after correcting initial typing and effect lint findings.

validation.name: Web export
validation.detail: Expo web export compiled the QR and camera dependencies successfully. This is not physical camera validation.

validation.name: Native APK and physical two-phone scanning
validation.detail: Build 14 running. No physical two-phone camera acceptance or installation yet. No public deployment.
